name: What are the best questions to ask an apartment builder before hiring them?

mainEntity.name: What should owners ask a contractor about multifamily experience, pricing, and schedule before starting a Los Angeles project?
mainEntity.text: What should owners ask a contractor about multifamily experience, pricing, and schedule before starting a Los Angeles project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before hiring an apartment builder, owners should focus on experience, process, and risk management rather than price alone. Important questions include whether the contractor has completed similar multifamily projects in Los Angeles, how they manage permits and inspections, how they control change orders, and who will actually supervise the job on site. It also helps to ask how they handle utility coordination, parking construction, and value engineering. Apartment projects are more complex than many single-family builds because they involve more trades, more inspections, and more opportunities for delay. A builder with local multifamily experience will usually have a better sense of what can derail a schedule or inflate the budget. Owners should also ask for a clear scope, a realistic timeline, and references from projects of similar size and complexity. The best contractor is one that can explain both the price and the assumptions behind it.
acceptedAnswer.description: Ask about similar projects, local permitting experience, budget controls, change-order handling, schedule management, subcontractor coordination, and who will supervise the job daily. For apartment construction, it also helps to ask how they handle parking, utilities, inspections, and value engineering.
